statusLabel: Medical market with adult-use framework and controlled pilot pathway
publicSummary: Priority European access market. Alpha source material indicates a large medical channel, import relevance and controlled adult-use evolution. Public use requires analyst review before presenting country-specific route claims.
regulatorLabel: BfArM / regional authorities

statusLabel: Medical market with tolerated retail and active export role
publicSummary: Established pharmaceutical-grade producer and EU export-origin market. Office for Medicinal Cannabis (OMC) oversees GMP cultivation. Active supply relationship with Germany, Italy and other EU medical markets.
regulatorLabel: Office for Medicinal Cannabis (OMC) / IGJ

statusLabel: Medical market
publicSummary: Medical access market with import and specialist-prescribing relevance. Alpha source content should be treated as directional until regulator and market-pathway fields are revalidated.
regulatorLabel: Home Office / MHRA

statusLabel: Medical pilot market — import pathway active
publicSummary: Medical access pilot launched in 2021 and extended into a permanent scheme. Import-dominant market with ANSM oversight. Pharmacy dispensing channel and hospital formulary access are primary commercial routes.
regulatorLabel: ANSM (Agence nationale de sécurité du médicament)

statusLabel: Medical market — domestic production and import channel
publicSummary: Medical market with domestic military-licensed cultivation (FM2) and active import programme. Chronic pain and neurological indications drive demand. Import supply from Netherlands and Canada is well-established.
regulatorLabel: AIFA (Agenzia Italiana del Farmaco) / Military Chemical Pharmaceutical Institute (FM2)

statusLabel: Emerging — social club framework and medical reform underway
publicSummary: Hybrid regulatory environment with social club tolerance at regional level and active medical-access reform. AEMPS oversight. Several regional governments pursuing independent access frameworks. Monitoring focus.
regulatorLabel: AEMPS (Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios)

statusLabel: Regulated medical and pilot adult-use framework
publicSummary: Switzerland operates a medical access channel and has an ongoing adult-use pilot in Basel, Berne and Zurich. Swissmedic oversight for medical. Pilot programme open to select registered adult participants. Active supply interest.
regulatorLabel: Swissmedic / Federal Office of Public Health (FOPH)

statusLabel: Medical market and cultivation/export hub
publicSummary: Medical access framework and active cultivation licensing for export. INFARMED oversight. Several licensed outdoor cultivation operations producing EU-GMP flower for European medical supply chains.
regulatorLabel: INFARMED (Autoridade Nacional do Medicamento e Produtos de Saúde)

statusLabel: Medical market — growing import demand
publicSummary: One of Europe's fastest-growing medical cannabis markets by patient count. Import-dominant, predominantly flower. GIF/URPL oversight. Pharmacy channel is the primary distribution route.
regulatorLabel: GIF (General Inspectorate of Pharmacy) / URPL

statusLabel: Medical market with adult-use reform in progress
publicSummary: Established medical framework and active legislative process toward regulated adult-use market. SUKL oversight. Growing domestic cultivation sector and import pipeline. Monitoring priority market.
regulatorLabel: SUKL (State Institute for Drug Control)

statusLabel: Regulated adult-use and medical — EU's first legal framework
publicSummary: First EU member state with a regulated adult-use framework (Cannabis Authority established 2021). Small domestic market with licensed cultivation and social club model. Supply chain and quality compliance monitoring.
regulatorLabel: Authority on the Responsible Use of Cannabis (ARUC)

statusLabel: Federal adult-use and medical market
publicSummary: Established regulated producer and export-origin market. Public fixture keeps only high-level market role and excludes non-public commercial counterparties, commercial terms, direct contact details and evidence records.
regulatorLabel: Health Canada

statusLabel: Federal Schedule I — state-licensed markets active in 38+ states
publicSummary: Complex federal-state regulatory patchwork. Medical markets active in 38+ states; adult-use in 24 states. Federal Schedule I status restricts interstate commerce and banking. Monitoring focus on rescheduling developments and state-by-state entry opportunities.
regulatorLabel: DEA / FDA (federal) + state-level cannabis boards

statusLabel: Medical market — adult-use framework pending
publicSummary: Medical regulation in force since 2017. Adult-use legislation passed Supreme Court threshold but implementing regulation remains outstanding. COFEPRIS oversight. Large domestic consumption and regional supply interest.
regulatorLabel: COFEPRIS (Federal Commission for Protection against Sanitary Risks)

statusLabel: Medical and cultivation/export pathway
publicSummary: Regional cultivation and export-origin candidate. Alpha signal material is quarantined from public output pending evidence review and date-stamped policy validation.
regulatorLabel: Ministry of Health / INVIMA

statusLabel: Medical access market
publicSummary: Large medical-access market with evolving policy and import relevance. Keep public presentation conservative until current regulator and product-access rules are rechecked.
regulatorLabel: ANVISA

statusLabel: Medical market
publicSummary: Medical cannabis market with import and domestic production relevance. Alpha source records should be normalized before use in public country pages.
regulatorLabel: TGA / ODC

statusLabel: Medical market — import dominant
publicSummary: Medical cannabis framework active since 2020. Medsafe oversight. Import-dominant with growing domestic licensed production. Adult-use referendum rejected in 2020; medical remains the active channel.
regulatorLabel: Medsafe / Ministry of Health

statusLabel: Established medical market — export programme active
publicSummary: One of the world's most developed medical cannabis ecosystems. IMCA oversight. Active export licensing programme for GMP-certified producers. High-quality flower and derivative exports to Europe and beyond.
regulatorLabel: Israeli Medical Cannabis Agency (IMCA) / Ministry of Health

statusLabel: Medical market — evolving adult-use regulatory posture
publicSummary: Thailand delisted cannabis from narcotics in 2022 and has since operated a mixed medical and commercial framework. Policy direction has shifted with subsequent governments. Monitoring priority for Asia-Pacific strategy.
regulatorLabel: Food and Drug Administration (Thai FDA) / Ministry of Public Health

statusLabel: Medical access reform — market opening under review
publicSummary: Japan amended the Cannabis Control Act in 2023 to permit medical cannabis use of non-psychoactive derivatives. Strict regulatory environment. PMDA oversight. Large addressable patient population makes this a long-term priority market.
regulatorLabel: PMDA (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency) / Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare

statusLabel: Medical and cultivation framework — export potential
publicSummary: South Africa has licensed medical cultivation and an emerging export programme. SAHPRA oversight. Favourable climate for outdoor cultivation at competitive cost. Priority market for Africa-region strategy and global supply sourcing.
regulatorLabel: SAHPRA (South African Health Products Regulatory Authority)

statusLabel: Emerging — reform signals active
publicSummary: West Africa's largest economy. NAFDAC oversight. Traditional cultivation regions well-established. Early-stage reform signals from health and trade ministries. Monitoring priority for long-term Africa market development.
regulatorLabel: NAFDAC (National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control)

statusLabel: Emerging — reform and industrial hemp framework
publicSummary: Ghana has an industrial hemp licensing framework and active discussions around medical access. FDA Ghana oversight. Strategic position for West Africa supply chain development.
regulatorLabel: FDA Ghana (Food and Drugs Authority)

statusLabel: Medical pilot market and active cultivation/export hub
publicSummary: Medical pilot programme since 2018. Active licensed cultivation with significant GMP flower production for domestic use and export. Several producers holding EU-GMP certification. Pharmacy distribution channel primary route.
regulatorLabel: Danish Medicines Agency (Laegemiddelstyrelsen)

statusLabel: Regulated adult-use — EU second regulated market
publicSummary: Luxembourg launched a home cultivation and personal use framework in 2023 with ongoing development toward retail. Small market but significant as the second EU member state to regulate adult use. Regulatory benchmark monitoring.
regulatorLabel: Ministry of Health / Ministry of Justice
